method: Second intensive static review; no sample execution or network contact
common_evidence: Read RULES.md and TAXONOMY.md before triage. Independently inspected the supplied bytes with cleave facts, decoded-string match views, PE parsing, Rizin and Capstone. Atomscan scores and prior review notes were not used as behavioral proof.
No executable, extracted payload or controller was run or contacted. All three supplied SHA-256 values still match.

The first two inputs differ in 49 bytes: the BotGenStudio build-path fragment, the SSDT-named cipher-key string, and the UTF-16 OriginalFilename token. The first two are replaced with X in sample 1; the Chrome filename is replaced in sample 2.

The UPX labels do not mean these files can be unpacked with upx -d: both contain populated recovered sections and reconstructed imports; UPX reports NotPacked. Entry 0x4089eb reaches CRT/GUI code and main calls loader 0x401170.

Loader 0x401170 takes the buffer at VA 0x42b3d0, skips its four-byte size field, and calls 0x4066e0/0x407a50 to recover bytes at 0x4ac660. It restores global ESP/EBP and registers, then jumps to that buffer at 0x401337. Independently decoded the Snappy stream: 126032 consumed bytes, 179432 output bytes, with an embedded native PE at decoded offset 0x2e8.

The recovered shellcode resolves exports by rotating name hashes, allocates executable memory and copies its body; it maps the embedded PE, resolves imports/relocations and transfers execution. The extracted PE contains real credential and surveillance routines, rather than merely strings in the outer binary.

Recovered PE: 0x410f11 constructs the nss3.dll path and resolves NSS_Init, key-slot/authentication APIs and PK11SDR_Decrypt through 0x4010c5 (LoadLibraryW/GetProcAddress). It also resolves sqlite3_open16/exec/close. 0x4114d2 opens signons.sqlite and dispatches a moz_logins SELECT with encryptedusername and encryptedpassword to callback 0x411258. 0x41119f invokes the resolved Base64 decoder and SDR decryptor and converts the returned credential bytes to UTF-16.

Recovered PE also registers raw input at 0x407cc0, reads input at 0x407905/0x4079ea, captures foreground-window titles, translates keyboard state with ToUnicodeEx at 0x407b3a and appends records. Clipboard data is acquired at 0x40a1ba. These routines and the concealed loader are incompatible with the claimed Chrome executable purpose. Authorized migration/recovery or accessibility context is not supplied.

In sample 2, code at 0x401923 initializes a 256-byte permutation, mixes bytes from the 32-byte SSDT-named string at VA 0x429854, swaps permutation entries and XORs the generated stream into caller buffers. The string is a cipher key, not a kernel helper or an SSDT-modification API. Replacing the key in sample 1 may affect interoperability; it does not turn the retained credential theft into benign functionality.

The x64 PEB byte patterns in these x86 containers are surrounded by genuine embedded x64 instructions in UPX1, not random strings. Retained their notable observation and changed descriptions to state PE instruction presence rather than claim current-architecture execution.
third_sample_evidence: CRT entry 0x40c85b reaches main 0x401081. Installation 0x401955 copies executable data and launches its generated path at 0x402207. It opens HKCU Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows into [ebp-0x1c40], but the Run write at 0x402250 passes [ebp-0x1c3c]. This supplied near miss does not establish working logon persistence. The separate TrayKey write at 0x402627 is coordination, not Run persistence.

0x402432 obtains resource bytes through 0x402974: FindResourceW/SizeofResource/LoadResource/LockResource, with the returned buffer in EBX and size in a stack slot. It passes buffer, size and an EBP-relative destination to 0x402278 at 0x4025c2. This helper extracts through 0x404f8b, appends random padding and calls 0x408bfe, which creates and writes the original destination. ShellExecuteW at 0x4025e6 receives the same EBP-relative path.

Resource IDR_BINARY/131 is a 181116-byte traditional encrypted deflate ZIP. Password 1234 yields CRC-verified HanAgent_pe.exe, 228352 bytes, SHA256 0742a171ff4693bb30cd153ca77039b1012b867ed7fa4aef30be00526ee55678. The member has a PECompact-style SEH unpacking entry at 0x41207a and four loader imports. Did not infer operational screenshots, injection, or game spying from the packed member or its name.

0x408b07 reads a 512-byte state record through file/raw-device helper paths, complements it and validates MSMP at 0x408b65; the corresponding write routine serializes complemented state. Adapter enumeration at 0x402b08 contributes to the request record.

0x40841e connects through 0x404808, sends command 3001 plus a 512-byte record and receives a list of remote file records. 0x408656 uses command 3002 to request a file; 0x404b67 reads length-prefixed AS101 frames and complements their payload; 0x404ee0 receives bytes to the file opened at 0x408827. Main checks and launches the generated download path at 0x4011ff. Network capability, state concealment, executable delivery and own-image cleanup tip the malicious verdict independently of the malformed Run write.

0x403141 obtains its module filename, formats the retry-until-gone delete template with that buffer twice, writes the batch and ShellExecutes it at 0x40327b. The new payload profile joins the independently bound resource/file/launch path with this cleanup, encrypted ZIP and complemented MSMP state. It asserts a co-occurring covert-loader profile, not successful payload installation.
The PhysicalDrive path reaches device queries and sector reads for configuration. File-write imports elsewhere do not prove disk overwrite, MBR infection, or destructive behavior; none was added.

Endpoint reachability, delivery provenance, user authorization and the fully unpacked child behavior remain unknown. No supplied deployment context supports an authorized installer or administration use.

changes: Consolidated CosmicDuke identity into packed-credential-stealer: require the independently detected concealed NSS/login-query behavior, with either builder path or cipher-key string as optional corroboration. Removed the names-only hostile alternative. Chrome filename is not required for family recognition. Sample 1 remains un-attributed at family level.

Added a neutral x86 resource-buffer staging/launch trait. Relative calls join the resource-returning helper to preparation and file writer; resource size, resource buffer, destination buffer, ShellExecuteW and file-write IAT targets are constrained. Added a hostile covert-loader profile requiring that chain, retry self-delete, encrypted resource ZIP and MSMP complement state. This does not depend on chosen filenames, IPs or working Run persistence.

Moved encrypted-zip-rsrc-pe from a behavior bucket to metadata/binary/resource/embedded-media, preserving Windows PE scope, 4096..52428800 byte size bounds and section matcher. Removed unsupported attack mapping from the property itself. Updated its WannaCry and new execution consumers. No source-ancestor archive selector existed.

Moved nine firing socket/init observations to their supported homes: DLL-name reference -> fs/path/library; gethostbyname/gethostbyaddr ordinals -> communications/dns/lookup; inet_addr -> communications/ip/parse; htons -> data/buffer/integer-codec; socket/connect/send/recv and the client API set -> their socket operations. Startup remains initialization. All exact consumers and the sole source-ancestor selector (SwiftTunnel) were updated; its any-list retains the original alternatives.

Separately strengthened seven ordinal observations to require pe.imports on WS2_32.dll, rather than unrelated ordinals co-occurring with a DLL string. Retained PE/DLL Windows scope and notable criticality. The library literal supplies inline YARA evidence and does not by itself satisfy the rule. Inert controls verify ownership and partial API sets.

Audited connect capacity after the relocation. Moved generic ConnectAsync text to metadata/lang/source/naming/function and unbound create_connection calls to data/control-flow/dispatch, preserving scope and exclusions and updating exact consumers. Audited dispatch capacity and moved PHP checkValid call-shaped text to metadata/lang/source/syntax/call; it does not prove a parsed invocation. Updated both exact consumers. No behavioral taxonomy split or budget increase was introduced.

Existing source-ancestor connect consumers were reviewed: generic method vocabulary is deliberately no longer a socket-connect alternative. New operation facts remain available to networking consumers. The migrated PHP rule had no dispatch ancestor consumer. Metadata target observations remain properties and do not establish execution.
Kept the genuine embedded x64 PEB observation, clarifying its description. Updated existing CosmicDuke regression expectations for the consolidated behavior-gated family identity.
additional_controls: Unbound Python create_connection call emits neutral dispatch, not the retired socket ID.
C# ConnectAsync text emits naming metadata, not the retired socket ID.
Quoted PHP checkValid( text emits syntax metadata, not a behavior invocation.
Re-run atomscan on all three full supplied paths; final high findings are recorded above. The third sample was re-scanned after ordinal ownership matcher changes.
final_required_check: make validate; if and only if a stale YARA precompile fingerprint is reported, make precompile then make validate again
